strings.intro.narration.arrival: Before Mid-Autumn, Osmanthus Street is hung full of lanterns. {player_name} just arrived at the street entrance and heard that the treasure of the lantern fair — the giant rabbit lantern — has flown away without wings.
strings.intro.line.granny_greeting: You are the detective who came to investigate the case? Good, good. That rabbit lantern was tied by my own hands, one bamboo one paper, and it accompanied the neighbours for forty Mid-Autumns. The thief who stole the lantern, I think, is a rabbit's tail — cannot be long!
strings.intro.line.kit_joke: Grandma, calm down! That rabbit is bigger than my car, who can steal it? Unless it escaped by itself and ran back to the moon to find Sister Chang'e to celebrate Mid-Autumn.
strings.intro.choice.ask: Go to the tea restaurant to ask the boss
strings.intro.ending.a: The colourful paper pieces led all the way to the rooftop: the rabbit lantern sat there well, and the broken ear was patched with new paper. It turned out Ah Kit secretly moved it to repair, wanting to give Grandma a surprise.
strings.intro.ending.b: The tea restaurant boss said while wiping the cup: 「Rabbit? Just sat on Ah Kit's motorcycle and left, still wearing a helmet.」 You rushed out the door, only saw a rabbit head floating farther and farther in the traffic……
strings.voice.line.granny_scold: Ah Kit boy, late again! Said good to deliver mooncakes at seven, now it is already seven thirty. Being a person needs "one promise, a thousand gold", understand or not?
strings.voice.line.kit_excuse: Grandma, I am wronged! Tonight all orders were full, I drove so fast I almost flew to the moon. Not one double yolk lotus seed paste was crushed, you should praise me!
strings.voice.line.granny_tease: Hmph, your mouth is faster than your car. Your generation, all day lowering heads to "clock in", cannot even tie one lantern, really each generation is not as good as the previous generation.
strings.voice.line.kit_soft: If cannot then learn. Grandma you teach me — your lantern although very old school, but really has feel, I am serious.
strings.voice.choice.teach: Please Grandma teach Ah Kit lanterns
strings.voice.choice.deliver: Let Ah Kit go deliver takeaway first
strings.voice.ending.a: Grandma scolded Ah Kit "clumsy hands and clumsy feet" with her mouth, but her hands never stopped, teaching him one bamboo strip by one bamboo strip to tie rabbit ears. At midnight, there was one more crooked-head small rabbit lantern on the table.
strings.voice.ending.b: Ah Kit jumped on the motorcycle, turned back and shouted: 「Grandma, tomorrow I help you carry the lantern, free!」 Grandma waved her hand: 「Go go, slow on the road, don't learn that rabbit to run around.」
strings.pun.line.king_intro: {player_name}, want to know the whereabouts of the rabbit lantern? First pass my level! Guess right, there is reward; guess wrong... I will 'moon' laugh 'moon' louder!
strings.pun.line.king_riddle: Listen well: "Little white rabbit, loves to play, lost its tail and is not afraid." — Guess one character!
strings.pun.choice.answer: It is the character "免"! The rabbit has no tail!
strings.pun.ending.a: The Lantern Riddle King stroked his beard and laughed: "Wonderful! The rabbit without tail is '免' — this clue is given to you for free: to find the lantern, you must 'wait'. When the moon climbs to the top of the archway, the rabbit will naturally appear."
strings.pun.ending.b: The Lantern Riddle King laughed until he bent his waist: "Mooncake? You are so hungry your brain has become lotus seed paste! Double yolk lotus seed paste, two eggs — exactly your score!"
strings.ui.hud.toast:
New clue!
{player_name} picked up rabbit hair at the archway.
strings.ui.ending.a: You raise {item_name} to shine at the memorial archway, unexpectedly the wall reflected a big rabbit's shadow — the rabbit lantern is nearby!
strings.ui.ending.b: You close the backpack, sit down to gnaw mooncake. From far away came Ah Kit's voice: 「Hey, {player_name}! The rabbit is here la!」
